title: Correct total length
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be 0.46 m (or 46 cm).

title: Correct pressure magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be approximately 2.29 N.

title: Equilibrium force analysis
description: Important: For part (1), correctly applies Hooke's law to find elongations x₁ and x₂ from the equilibrium of m₁+m₂ and m₂ respectively.

title: Spring compression analysis
description: Important: For part (2), recognizes that when total length equals original sum, both springs are compressed/stretched by the same amount x, and sets up m₁ equilibrium: k₁x + k₂x = m₁g.

title: Plate force equilibrium
description: Important: For part (2), correctly analyzes forces on m₂ (weight, spring 2 force, normal force from plate) to find the normal force/pressure.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (meters, Newtons, kg) throughout calculations.

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall: Misidentifies direction of spring forces (tension vs compression) in the equilibrium equations, leading to incorrect signs.

title: Confusing spring states
description: Pitfall: Assumes both springs are in the same state (both stretched or both compressed) in part (2) without proper analysis of the lifting condition.
